title: collectReward with zero totalStaked is silently lossy: rewardPerSecond is set immediately, but _updatePool early-returns when totalStaked==0, allowing the depletion clock to consume funded rewards before any staker can claim

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-10 'Zero APY operation is supported and expected'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-10 covers zero APY, not zero totalStaked. Finding is a funder-side value leak when collectReward is called with no stakers. Distinct.
